layer.name: Duval succession crisis
layer.notes: Sample investigation layer focused on the Imperial succession crisis following Hengist Duval's death. Try opening the local graph of Arissa Lavigny-Duval, Aisling Duval, Denton Patreus, the Imperial Senate, or Treaty of Cartoi.

nodeNotes.sample-duval-succession-fault-line: The succession crisis begins with [[id:6b07ceac-7fe6-43c0-98c9-460049eb1d7c][Death of Hengist Duval]] and is processed through the [[id:6b539fa1-7ebe-44d3-874b-41a3bd400af9][Imperial Senate]]. The rival poles are [[id:34f3cfdd-0536-40a9-8732-13bf3a5e4a70][Arissa Lavigny-Duval]] and [[id:b402bbe3-5119-4d94-87ee-0ba279658383][Aisling Duval]], while [[id:75daea85-5e9f-4f6f-a102-1a5edea0283c][Denton Patreus]] and [[id:e9679720-e0c1-449e-86a6-a5b3de3613f5][Anders Blaine]] influence the outcome.
nodeNotes.sample-duval-legitimacy-through-marriage: The interrupted marriage between [[id:3cb0755e-4deb-442b-898b-3f0c6651636e][Hengist Duval]] and [[id:33f63de9-fd79-4790-a1a5-ebd87aaeea2d][Florence Lavigny]] would have strengthened [[id:34f3cfdd-0536-40a9-8732-13bf3a5e4a70][Arissa Lavigny-Duval]]'s legal position. This makes the wedding attack a constitutional turning point. See [[node:sample-duval-succession-fault-line][Succession fault line]].
nodeNotes.sample-duval-patreus-calculus: Was [[id:75daea85-5e9f-4f6f-a102-1a5edea0283c][Denton Patreus]] trying to use a deadlocked [[id:6b539fa1-7ebe-44d3-874b-41a3bd400af9][Imperial Senate]] to increase his leverage over both [[id:b402bbe3-5119-4d94-87ee-0ba279658383][Aisling Duval]] and [[id:34f3cfdd-0536-40a9-8732-13bf3a5e4a70][Arissa Lavigny-Duval]]? Compare this line of inquiry with [[node:sample-duval-succession-fault-line][Succession fault line]] and [[id:3f567b7e-8f20-480b-b485-20b59de6191e][Imperial Succession Vote in Senate Today]].
nodeNotes.sample-duval-cartoi-pressure-valve: [[id:ff4e4a1a-1643-4da5-94f4-2592750f9ec2][Treaty of Cartoi]] suggests that supporters of [[id:34f3cfdd-0536-40a9-8732-13bf3a5e4a70][Arissa Lavigny-Duval]] and [[id:b402bbe3-5119-4d94-87ee-0ba279658383][Aisling Duval]] could still de-escalate locally after [[id:6b07ceac-7fe6-43c0-98c9-460049eb1d7c][Hengist's death]]. This may be evidence that the crisis was real but still containable. Compare with [[node:sample-duval-succession-fault-line][Succession fault line]].
nodeNotes.sample-duval-questions-to-test:
- Did [[id:3f567b7e-8f20-480b-b485-20b59de6191e][Imperial Succession Vote in Senate Today]] reflect a real deadlock or political theatre?
- Does [[node:sample-duval-patreus-calculus][Patreus calculus]] explain later alignments?
- Is [[node:sample-duval-legitimacy-through-marriage][Legitimacy through marriage]] the cleanest explanation for [[id:34f3cfdd-0536-40a9-8732-13bf3a5e4a70][Arissa Lavigny-Duval]]'s rise?
- Is [[node:sample-duval-cartoi-pressure-valve][Cartoi as pressure valve]] the best evidence that the succession crisis stopped short of civil war?
